in_latin.name: Millicent
in_latin.meaning: Meaning of Millicent, a Germanic name derived from Latin and Celtic roots
in_latin.long_meaning: Millicent is a Germanic name derived from Latin and Celtic roots, meaning 'strong and mighty in battle', with the suffix '-cent' meaning 'thousand', denoting strength and power. In early Christian church, Millicent was associated with virtues such as courage and resilience, reflecting the name's origins in the Latin word 'militare', meaning 'to serve as a soldier'.
